item.title: [Kannada] [OTT Release] Corporate Love Story
item.description:
Source91Mobiles OTT
LanguageKannada
CategoryOTT Release
Release Date27 Nov 2026

The series revolves around Nithya, an ambitious young designer, and Arjun, a disciplined product head, working at a struggling startup called 'Uniquus Tech' in Bengaluru. As they collaborate on launching a new dating app, their initial friction blossoms into a romance. However, their relationship is tested by the pressures of the corporate world, career challenges, office politics, and personal expectation
